body.claim: Canonical must not be marked non_exhaustive, unlike every other public enum here.
body.detail: The specification closes the set of canonical values at null, boolean, integer, string, array and object. A consumer matching on it should be forced to handle all six, because a seventh would be a format change and the compiler complaining is the point. Marking it non_exhaustive would hand every downstream match a wildcard to hide a new value behind — the opposite of what the attribute does for kinds and rungs, where growth must be free for the ecosystem.
